The VPC-based OpenSearch domain requires the AWSServiceRoleForAmazonElasticsearchService service-linked role to already exist, otherwise the first `terraform apply` fails with "You must create the service-linked role for Amazon ES". The example defines `aws_iam_service_linked_role.opensearch` (gated by `var.create_iam_service_linked_role`) precisely for this, but `aws_elasticsearch_domain.opensearch` never references it and has no `depends_on`, so nothing orders the role before the domain. Add `depends_on = [aws_iam_service_linked_role.opensearch]` on the domain.

`aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng` lists `aws_iam_role.managed_ng` in `depends_on`, but `node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.managed_ng.arn` already creates that dependency implicitly; the entry can be dropped (keep the instance profile and policy-attachment entries, which are not referenced).

`null_resource.update_trust_policy` lists `aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution` in `depends_on`, but the local-exec command already interpolates `${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}`, which establishes the same ordering implicitly.

`null_resource.update_trust_policy` lists `kubernetes_namespace.spark` in `depends_on`, but the local-exec command already interpolates `${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}`, which establishes the same ordering implicitly.

`module "aws_eks_teams"` sets `depends_on = [module.aws_eks]`, but it already passes `eks_cluster_id = module.aws_eks.cluster_id` (and `tags` from `module.eks_tags`), so the dependency on `module.aws_eks` is established implicitly and the explicit entry is redundant.

`module "emr_on_eks"` lists `module.aws_eks` in `depends_on`, but it already passes `eks_cluster_id = module.aws_eks.cluster_id`, which establishes that ordering implicitly. Keep only `kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` in the `depends_on` list.

`aws_eks_addon.aws_ebs_csi_driver` lists `module.irsa_addon` in `depends_on`, but `service_account_role_arn` already references `module.irsa_addon.irsa_iam_role_arn` in its expression, so the dependency is already implied.

`aws_eks_addon.vpc_cni` lists `module.irsa_addon` in `depends_on`, but `service_account_role_arn` already references `module.irsa_addon.irsa_iam_role_arn` in its expression, so the dependency is already implied.
